status: Stable design acceptance for a new hypothesis and downstream decisive plan, not acceptance of independent measured benefit.
accepted: L-M: a successful source fill should preserve the maximum simultaneous assignment capacity of unresolved legal hot-output obligations; use a safe ordinary victim or actual permission-checked no-fill delivery.
Root's overlapping {X,Y}/{Y} example proves independent per-job hit counts miss an assignment-capacity loss. Matching/Hall are standard, not claimed new mathematics.
Full-FREE matching admission is necessary with overlapping subsets; scalar free credit is insufficient. Exact metadata and complete permission paths are paid.
BIND transfers to a fixed owned singleton until accepted actual normal WRITE translation. Clearing at FREE->COPY is invalid.
L-W: new set-valued WRITE goal can choose a leaf under an already-validated shared prefix before next PTE AR firstVALID. It must use a new immutable goal contract.

Cross-address actual-lease withdrawal can stop optional orphan suffixes before unpublished PTE AR. Agent19/51 vs22/54 is accepted only as its stated conditional suffix schedule with a common charged prefix; not an original-start win.
All already-published AXI requests remain stable and complete; no permissions inferred from lease, hint or unaccepted VALID.

Every pool allocation path must preserve full assignment feasibility. BIND chooses from a full matching maximizing hot slots, not an arbitrary hot-only edge; standard matching extension supplies the construction and is not new mathematics.

The overlap example needs co-live output ownership, e.g. consumer joins both outputs before either release. If sequential hot-slot reuse is legal, ordinary wait/reuse is a full-cost control; never force a cold fallback.
excluded_as_independent_claims: Matching/Hall theorem, hot-first, source-role bypass, dead-page prediction, pinning, shadow cache, deferred placement, PWC prefix reuse, low-priority walk preemption/cancel/replay, generic output-pool API.

319/479 root named bits,212 placement bits and543 cancellation bits are not complete implementation area. They have different contracts/subsets and may share fields; do not sum them or combine into a net advantage.
The 2-way overlap illustration is not a16-entry trace. Ordinary safe victim, resize/borrowing, full prepare, extra entries and efficient continuation remain controls.

recommendation.main: L-M as a conditional mechanism-design priority: contract-driven cache admission preserving joint output choice capacity.
recommendation.backup: L-W as a conditional goal-directed walk/architecture alternative; cancel+PWC matches PTE count and must be a complete control.
recommendation.support: Lease-triggered optional cancellation is a component/control rather than a new generic cancel algorithm; local k-choice guard is a cheaper disjoint-pool ablation.

innovation_judgments.newness: If a primary published design covers this precise COPY-choice/ownership-coupled operation, its covered action cannot be claimed independently. Current targeted passages cover many components but do not establish that full contract.
innovation_judgments.benefit: Because exact set-aware pin+bypass and cancel+PWC can reproduce the displayed local actions/counts, those local hand examples alone cannot prove an independently faster algorithm. Compare real paid joint V/A and implementation frontier, adopting the simplest equivalent implementation.
innovation_judgments.formation: If a legal original workload provides useful joint V/A or complete cost ability that executable existing independent controls cannot reproduce at the same resource budget, and nearest primary work has not covered the contract-driven rule, the integrated mechanism can form an independent contribution.
innovation_judgments.not_a_requirement: The candidate need not beat an imagined algorithm supplied with its entire same new rule. Do not use absence of a universal superiority/novelty proof to block a small decisive model.
innovation_judgments.publication: No venue/quartile promise; no new measured result or first-invention proof.
